Apple___Apple_scab.description: Apple scab is a fungal disease caused by Venturia inaequalis. It affects leaves and fruit, causing olive-brown spots.
symptoms: Olive-brown or velvety spots on leaves
treatments: Apply fungicides containing captan or myclobutanil
Prune trees to improve air circulation
Apply fungicides preventively during wet seasons
prevention: Apply dormant oil sprays in early spring

Apple___Black_rot.description: Black rot is caused by the fungus Botryosphaeria obtusa. It affects fruit, leaves, and branches.
symptoms: Brown spots with purple borders on leaves
prevention: Maintain tree vigor through proper fertilization

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Late blight is a devastating disease caused by Phytophthora infestans. It can destroy entire crops quickly.
symptoms: White fungal growth on leaf undersides
prevention: Apply preventive fungicides in humid conditions

Potato___Early_blight.description: Early blight is caused by Alternaria solani fungus. It primarily affects older leaves and can reduce yields.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on leaves
prevention: Maintain plant health with proper fertilization

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust.description: Common rust is caused by Puccinia sorghi fungus. It's most severe in cool, humid conditions.
symptoms: Small, circular to elongate brown pustules on leaves
treatments: Spray at first sign of disease
prevention: Time planting to avoid peak infection periods

Grape___Black_rot.description: Grape black rot is caused by Guignardia bidwellii fungus. It can cause severe crop losses.
